product_metadata.title: Craig Frames 23247778 24 by 24-Inch Picture Frame, Smooth Wrap Finish, 1-Inch Wide, Brazilian Walnut Brown
features: Contemporary style; dark brown wood grain appearance; smooth laminate wrap finish
Frame includes: clear acrylic facing, rigid cardboard backing and wire hanging hardware kit (some assembly required)
Frame holds a 24 inch by 24 inch photo/print/poster (viewable area reduced by .25" on each side due to frame lip)
Frame moulding is 1 inch wide; MDF wood composite
Frame is designed for WALL HANGING only (hanging hardware allows for portrait or landscape orientation)
